title: Albania Signs World Bank Agreement for NSW Implementation
author: NSW Team
excerpt: Albania signed the financing agreement with the World Bank for a 5.9 million USD IBRD loan to implement the National Single Window system.
content: On June 10, 2024, the Republic of Albania officially signed the financing agreement with the World Bank for the implementation of the National Single Window (NSW) project. The 5.9 million USD IBRD loan will cover the development, implementation, and operationalization of the NSW system over a five-year period.

The signing ceremony took place at the Ministry of Economy and Innovation, attended by the Minister of Finance and Economy and the World Bank Country Director for the Western Balkans. Both parties emphasized the importance of this investment for modernizing Albania's trade infrastructure.

The funds will be allocated across several key components: development of the NSW technology platform, institutional capacity building, harmonization of the legal and regulatory framework, and project management support. A significant portion of the funding will be dedicated to training staff at participating agencies.

This financing represents the international community's commitment to supporting Albania in meeting international trade facilitation standards, including the requirements of Article 10.4 of the WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement and UN/CEFACT Recommendation No. 33.
The agreement paves the way for the project implementation phase, which is expected to begin with the establishment of governance structures and the recruitment of the project's technical team.
